## Brand Strategy
- **Brand story**: "Welcome to The New Possible" -- positions automation as unlocking new ways of working.
- **Audience**: "Automation heroes" -- systems-thinkers always looking to improve the way work is done; advocates who grow trust and adoption across organizations.
- **Belief**: "We do our most awesome work when technology works for us." (internal guiding ethos, reserved for key moments of impact and inspiration).
- **Mission**: "Make automation work for everyone." (public-facing, used with care at hero moments -- about page, events).
- **Values / Purpose**: Referenced in TOC (Brand Foundations section includes Belief, Mission, Values, Purpose).
- **Structure**: 5 chapters -- 01 Vision (Brand Story, Audience), 02 Brand Foundations (Belief, Mission, Values, Purpose), 03 Messaging (Persona, Our Voice, Tone Spectrum, Headline Bank, Tagline), 04 Brand Identity (Logo, Logo Usage, Best Practices, Logo in Partner Directories, The Platform, Art Library), 05 Brand System (Typography, Color, Photography).

## Logo
- **Wordmark**: Custom "zapier" logotype in lowercase, white on dark brown/near-black background on cover. Features distinctive geometric letterforms with rounded terminals.
- **Accent element**: Orange rectangular bar positioned to the left/below the "z" -- acts as a brand mark accent (resembles an underscore or automation "trigger" block).
- **Colorways**: White on dark, likely dark on light variants (based on TOC referencing Logo Usage and Best Practices sections).
- **Partner directory usage**: Dedicated section for logo use in partner directories (page range not sampled).

## Typography
- **Display / Headlines**: Heavy-weight grotesque sans-serif (extra bold/black weight), used prominently in belief and mission statements. Tight tracking, large scale.
- **Body text**: Clean sans-serif, lighter weight, well-spaced for readability.
- **Hierarchy**: Strong contrast between display (very bold, large) and body (regular weight, smaller). Section labels in italic or medium weight.
- **Typography section**: Covered in Chapter 05 Brand System (not directly sampled in pages read).

- Headline Bank is an unusual and practical inclusion for brand consistency.
- Partner directory-specific logo guidelines suggest mature B2B integration ecosystem.
